nav_note: Notional $10m used to express risk and trades in dollars; scale to actual capital.
horizon: Positions are typically held for days to a few weeks, so the model uses a six-month lookback with a fast-reacting (30-day half-life) covariance and reports one-day and one-week risk.

rule.description: Own names in a long-term uptrend (price above the 200-day average), short only names in a confirmed downtrend (price below the 50-day and 200-day averages with the 50-day below the 200-day), stay flat on the rest. Equal risk per name, no name above 25% of book risk, the whole book scaled towards 15% volatility but never levered beyond 100% gross. A name must move 5% through its average before its direction changes, and is only resized when its target moves materially, so the book drifts rather than churns.
